title: Guyana and French Guiana: oil, a spaceport and a border dispute
goal: Talk about Guyana's oil, the Essequibo dispute and the spaceport at Kourou, using imagined situations with si + imperfect subjunctive.
grammar: hypothetical conditions with si + imperfect subjunctive

sections.title: Guyana and French Guiana: oil, a spaceport and a border dispute
body: In this lesson you read about two neighbours: Guyana, an English-speaking country that found oil offshore, and French Guiana, part of France, where Europe launches its rockets. You will also read the two positions in the dispute between Venezuela and Guyana over the Essequibo, and the steps of the court case.

The grammar is one you know: *si* + imperfect subjunctive, for imagined situations. The screens and instructions are in English; the readings are in Spanish. (Belize, Guyana and Suriname are not Spanish-speaking countries: their official languages are English and Dutch.)

items: I can say what would happen in an imagined situation with *si* + imperfect subjunctive and the conditional.
I can say what each side claims in the Essequibo dispute, without taking sides.
I can use the new words for rockets, fuel and oil fields.
